title: myrtus baetica
intro: Myrtus baetica, commonly known as Bois de Chypre, is a plant species that belongs to the Myrtaceae family and is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrtus baetica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Myrtus baetica, including tannins and essential oils, have been found to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
